claim: On Amazon.com a 6x9, 120-page black-ink KDP paperback costs $2.44 to print and keeps $1.06 a copy at $6.99 (50% rate), $3.55 at $9.99 and $5.35 at $12.99 (60% rate); in premium colour printing is $8.80, so at $12.99 the royalty is -$1.01.
notes: Real-time capture of the live free calculator at 360x640 CSS px, 3x device pixels. The grey ring marks each tap. Figures are KDP's published Amazon.com rates (royalty: 50% at or below $9.98, 60% at $9.99 and up; regular-trim black ink $1.00 + $0.012/page; premium colour $1.00 + $0.065/page). The two KDP help pages are Amazon's own, listed after our calculator. The final 2.2 s hold the colour result still for the end card.
